message.content: Based on the information provided, there is no direct mention of Li Hua telling Wolfgang about his new friend, Yuriko, before the group discussed the Music Festival. In the first interaction, Li Hua introduces Yuriko to Wolfgang, saying, "Hey guys! Just wanted to introduce you both since I think you'll hit it off! Yuriko, this is Wolfgang, my best buddy." This indicates that Li Hua had already introduced Yuriko to Wolfgang before they discussed the Music Festival. Therefore, it appears that Wolfgang did not receive information about Li Hua's new friend, Yuriko, from Li Hua before the group planned for the Music Festival.
